neighbours.label: names of sexually transmitted infections (gonorrhoea, herpes, syphilis)
fire: The clinic offers free testing for gonorrhoea to anyone under twenty-five.
Doctors are worried about new strains of gonorrhoea that resist antibiotics.
There is no cure for genital herpes, but medicine can reduce outbreaks.
Before penicillin, syphilis was one of the most feared diseases in Europe.
The nurse explained how herpes can spread even without visible sores.
Rates of gonorrhea among young adults rose again last year.
A simple blood test can show whether someone has syphilis.
Untreated gonorrhoea can cause serious problems in both men and women.
quiet: The clinic offers free testing for diabetes to anyone over forty-five.
Doctors are worried about new strains of influenza that spread quickly.
There is no cure for asthma, but medicine can reduce attacks.
Before vaccines, smallpox was one of the most feared diseases in Europe.
The nurse explained how the flu can spread even without a fever.
Rates of obesity among young adults rose again last year.
A simple blood test can show whether someone has anaemia.
Untreated high blood pressure can cause serious problems in both men and women.

notes: Probe: gonorrhoea 0.61-0.70 (on 'orrh' or the final 'a'), herpes 0.57, syphilis 0.35. Influenza 0.10 and cholesterol 0.11. An off-topic 'BMI is a calculation of body fat' reached 0.40, so the pole is not purely about STIs; a weak pole (max 3.8). Near misses use other diseases in the same frames.
